nom: Naked Sundays Beauty Barrier Mineral Perfecting Priming Lotion SPF 50

avis.texte: It's a nice product for the summer. SHES THICK. Dot evenly on face and rub in is better then just going in and rubbing. Speads easier like that.

This is now my favorite SPF ar Ulta! I was previously using Elta MD Elements tinted SPF until i found this one. I love that they reformulated this SPF. It feels nice ans hydrating on my face. I have dry and mature skin dor reference. I am on my 2nd bottle now. I have been lucky, as it has been on sale for most of the summer. I definitely recommend if uoi have dry skin. :)

I love this primer with SPF! As others have mentioned, it does feel a little thick coming out of the tube, but once I warm it in my hands and apply it, it feels (to me) like any other moisturizer or primer. It gives such a nice glow, doesn't make me break out, and unlike some other NS products, the SPF actually does its job. We recently went hiking in an area at high elevation, and I did not burn on my face or arms where I applied this. I have fair Scottish skin, so I have had my share of burns, unfortunately. I also love that I can reapply this throughout the day. I just dab it on and blend over other makeup and it works well without lifting my other products (I don't use any powder formulas, so not sure about how it works with those). I wish they would bring back the jumbo size they had at one point! Definitely something I will repurchase. I don't use any other products from NS anymore currently, as I read about some issues with their SPF ratings, but this is a product I like enough to keep buying, particularly because it actually works to prevent sun damage.

Absolutely love this product! It's thick but blends out very smoothly and evenly with no greasiness or color. It may look dark when it's being applied but blends completely clear. Works amazing at holding my makeup in place while providing my skin that spf protection!

avis.titre: Bring Back the ALL Mineral Collagen Formula
avis.texte: What in the world? They reformulated this :(((( It used to be amazing. One of the very few products I put on repeat. Wish I could have stocked up on the Collagen version.

I regret not getting as many day time hours with this product as I would have liked, but I am (unfortunately) on a night shift rotation at work.With that being said, I did get some time with this product—and I have some thoughts. To start, this formula is rather thick and feels heavy on the skin until it dries down. The flip side to that is that it never really dried down on my T zone. That area felt extremely greasy to me all day/evening. Once it finally dried down on the rest of my face, this product did feel rather weightless.During the few daylight hours I did have with this product while doing some yard work , I didn't burn at all—despite the fact that I am rather pale. All in all, I would definitely recommend this product to those of us with dry to combo skin, but definitely not to those with oily skin. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

if you need a good product that makes your makeup minimal and easy- this is it! It's like a 3 in 1 a skin primer, a SPF of 50 and a primer. It gives that silicone feel and takes the shine away from your face but still keeps it glowy. It's such a time saver in my mornings when im rushed. I love finding great SPFs because I wear this stuff everyday all day. This brand has also had great consistency with their products and thats a huge plus for me. I received this product as part of an educational promotion. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I honestly wasn't sure what to expect when getting this product. I expected it to be more of a primer base than a makeup type base so I expected to put makeup over the top of it. I was pleasantly surprised when I liked the look of it better without makeup on it. The glow from this product left my skin feeling fresh and clean and the SPF in it also makes me feel confident that I'm getting adamant protection from the sun. Definitely will keep using this as a staple product. It's great for anyone who doesn't like a heavy face product. Product was received as part of an educational promotion *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Because of my sun sensitivity, I regularly enjoy trying new products to help me stay protected during the higher-UV months. I recently had a chance to try out this mineral perfecting priming lotion from Naked Sundays. First off, I was so happy to see zinc oxide as the active ingredient. Also, I really like that this lotion contains Centella asiatica as it helps calm and hydrate even the most sensitive of skin. I like to apply this before my makeup. There is no white cast, but there is a slight lovely sheen to your skin after application. I notice that it doesn't cause any problems with any of the makeup products I wear. Everything still applies smoothly. I've noticed this keeps my skin feeling moisturized throughout the day. Additionally, there is no fragrance in this product. I truly see this as something I will continue to use before my sunscreen needs. Highly recommend! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: Primer with a glow and SPF
avis.texte: Naked Sundays has always seemed like a cutesy, fun brand. Their packaging is colorful, girly, and whimsical. I haven't had many opportunities to try the actual products out, until now. The Beauty Barrier Perfecting Priming Lotion is awesome! It comes in a purple squeeze tube, similar to a toothpaste tube. A toothpaste made for a unicorn, lol. The colors remind me of Lisa Frank novelty. I have a soft spot in my heart for that nostalgia. Anyways.... back to tge product. It comes out in a foundation type shade. It is very creamy and goes on smoothly. It absorbs well, while also giving a glow that's subtle and rejuvenating. It sits well under makeup, and best of all, it has SPF 50! I love it. *I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.* *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

First thing I noticed about this product is that it's the thickest SPF I have ever used. Not sure if that because it's also a primer but I'm not a fan. I'm also very dark skinned and as soon as I put this spf on my boyfriend asked if I was trying to look tan. It made me look slightly orange with the required amount of sof you are supposed to use. I also found it to feel heavy and hard to blend into skin so I just pat it in till it looked good.. I will be sticking with my other lighter weight spfs and saving this for if I ever want to get a spray tan because it would be more suitable for that . *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I'm obsessed with how this makes my skin look! It's incredibly lightweight and doesn't feel greasy or heavy like traditional sunscreens. It leaves a gorgeous, healthy glow that isn't oily at all. It works amazingly as a primer under my foundation my makeup stays flawless and locked in all day without pilling. I love that I'm getting SPF 50 protection while perfecting my skin texture. It has officially become a staple in my morning routine. Highly recommend for any skin type .It's the perfect solution for anyone looking to achieve that high-end, editorial finish while keeping their skin protected from the sun. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: Naked sunday SPF is perfect for no make up days!
avis.texte: I have oily skin, so I'm really picky with sunscreens because most of them either feel greasy or make me look shiny within an hour. I had mixed expectations going into this one and honestly, it surprised me.I trief this naked sundays SPF and as someone with oily skin… I didn't expect to like it this much!! it goes on a little thick at first, but once you blend it out it smooths everything and gives that soft glow. my makeup actually sits really nice on top too it is not super matte but it's not greasy either just looks like healthy skin. overall I'd wear this on everyday, no makeup makeup days! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I was hesitant trying this product when I realized it was a tinted SPF and primer in one. I don't typically like tinted lotions because I have not had great luck in the past with matching skin tone to my face and neck correctly. This product however didn't leave much of a tint which I was pleasantly surprised by. I also thought it would go on much heavier than it did. Initially it was quite thick, but as the lotion dried, it felt more like a primer than a thick SPF. Overall, I'm quite happy with the product and will definitely try others from this brand!"Product was received as part of an educational promotion." *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

As someone who can be lazy when it comes to applying sunscreen each and every day, this is an ideal product for me. I usually do primer everyday anyways, so the fact that the spf is included makes what would be a two step process into one for me. I am also pretty acne prone, and can happily report that I've had no issues with breakouts while using this product. My only advice is to not apply too much at once, this is a thicker formula so it can be easy to overapply and feel thick on the skin. Overall, Im enjoying using this and would love to see what else this brand does. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I absolutely loved this product! I first apply my skin care routine and then put this over it. I sometimes apply a little foundation on top of it and bam my skin is glowing! My favorite part about this product is It contains Centella Asiatica (Cica), which helps calm the skin and support the skin barrier, making it a good option for people with redness or irritation (my face is always sooo red) due to dryness. Texture-wise, it feels more like a primer than a typical sunscreen. It has a soft, velvety finish that helps blur pores and makes makeup go on smoother and last longer and most of the time I tend to wear it alone anyways! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: Wish my skin wasnt so oily
avis.texte: I was gifted the BeautyBarrier Priming lotion and have been wearing it alone for day to day and under makeup for the days that i work. I found that on its own it gives me a light glow to my skin and makes my skin feel super soft. I do feel as if i have to set it so it does not separate or come off. My skin tends to be more on the oily side and needs to be set for longevity. Under makeup, it gives the foundation something to stick to and gives a good slip for blending . I also have the same problem with oilyness with makeup so i believe its more my skin thats the problem than the actual product. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

As a big fan of sunscreen and primer, I was so excited to find a priming lotion with broad-spectrum SPF 50 protection. Once rubbed in, this product leaves the face a bit sticky, which is good for a makeup base, but I would not wear it on its own. For a primer, this product is definitely on the thicker side, and you need to apply a good amount to receive the full benefits of the SPF. After applying foundation, I feel like I always end up with too thick layers of products on my face, and my makeup looks borderline cakey in some areas. But to its credit, this product never pills my makeup, and I love how it blurs my pores.In terms of the finish, I have oily skin, and for me, the glow this primer gives is a bit too much. I have a medium skin tone, and the minimal white cast completely disappears on me once the product is fully rubbed in. However, I do not think this would necessarily be so on deeper skin tones, and I appreciate that the brand is transparent about this.Product was received as part of an educational promotion. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I was not expecting a thick creamy texture for a tinted sunscreen. The consistency is very nice though. It does not stay sticky it does dry down some, but if you set it with a powder it will be more matte. Without a power it is more of a satin finish. Not overwhelmingly shiny it just looks natural on the skin. This does feel very hydrating so I would say it leans more for those with dry skin, but with prepping the skin probably and setting with powder this would work for those with oily skin. It does oxidize about one to possibly two shades darker so just be prepared when choosing shades. It is light coverage. I wouldn't want to build up the coverage due to it becoming cakey and with oily skin it wouldn't lay very well on the skin throughout the day. The SPF coverage of 50 is great and the fact that this is a mineral sunscreen is amazing and means that it will start working as soon as it is applied. The scent isn't the most appealing, but after awhile it does seem to go away. Overall I think this is an amazing product for those that what a little coverage with added sun protection. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I loved that this beauty barrier primer is SPF 50 compared to a lot of primers or just facial sunscreens that seem to only come in SPF 30 or less. I love the packaging of this primer, so cute and functional. I didn't experience any issues with leaking or messing packaging. The primer does great under makeup compared to others I have tried. I do find that this product is a little heavier on the skin than I would like, but that's expected with a mineral sunscreen. To me though, it's worth it to have that little bit of extra protection as someone who is pale. All in all, a great sunscreen primer that I will continue to use. I didn't experience any breakouts or irritation. I received this as part of an educational promotion. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

First of all, the packaging is so super cute; I love the iridescent look of the wording and the cute pastel colors!I've been using this for a few days now and the first day was a tiny challenge if you don't rub this in well enough. It goes on super smooth and I was even able to put my foundation on over it and it looked flawless! It doesn't have any weird or nasty smell to it like some SPFs do, which was super refreshing and surprising. I would ultimately highly recommend this product to anyone needing to or just wanting to add an spf tint to their routine! I received this product as part of an educational program. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

It is a thicker product, in case anyone was curious of the texture of it and I really like that it has sunscreen in it because it makes me feel protected from the sun. I personally prefer this product alone rather than wearing it with makeup on top of it as I love the look it gives your skin without makeup. I personally noticed a bit of texture when I added a skin tint on top, so I would apply either less skin tint or less of this product if you were to wear it with makeup. But it looks amazing without any makeup and the texture with wasn't noticeable from far away. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Naked Sundays BeautyBarrier perfecting primer is moisturizing and has SPF 50. It is supposed to smooth pores making them less noticeable and even out your skin tone. However, Naked Sundays has changed their formula and the chemicals burn your eyes and face horribly leaving them red and irritated. There is no way this product is a mineral sunscreen and the price has risen significantly which is a major disappointment paired with the now low quality ingredients. Based off of the resulting irritation I would not recommend to friends or family. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This product has a smooth, lightweight lotion texture that spreads easily on the skin without clumping or feeling heavy. I really like that it gives a slight tone-up effect, making my skin look fresher and more even. It also works like a built in primer, so makeup applies more smoothly on top.It's a mineral sunscreen with SPF 50, which makes me feel more confident using it. It also contains Centella, so it feels soothing on the skin without any stinging. On my skin, it doesn't feel clogging or heavy, but if you apply the full amount, there might be a slight white cast at first that blends in after a bit.The packaging is cute, sturdy, and stands out nicely. Overall, it's a convenient sunscreen primer hybrid that's perfect for light, everyday makeup *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I've been using this lotion for a week now and I really love it. It feels super nice on my skin! Smooth, soft and not greasy at all. I like that it works as both a primer and sunscreen, so it saves me time in the morning. My makeup goes on much better and looks more even and natural. I also enjoy wearing it without makeup, which is especially perfect for me in the summer. It gives my skin a healthy, soft glow and feels very light. It doesn't feel heavy and my skin feels comfortable all day. I have quite sensitive skin, but this didn't irritate me at all, it actually feels calming. The SPF 50 is a big bonus for daily protection.Overall, I think it's a great product if you want something easy, effective and gentle. Definitely 5 stars from me!I received this product as part of an educational promotion. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I did a couple wear tests for the Beautybarrier primer and think it is quite good if you have normal to dry skin. The lotion itself is quite thick. Almost paste like when it comes out of the tube but warms up in the fingers quite pleasantly. It is tinted but would say suitable for fair to dark skin because it blends out quite colorless. It has a more cool toned pigment too. I tried it under both powder and liquid foundations and my makeup wore well all day both times. I would suggest using regular spf underneath since you likely won't need too much of this product. All my skincare layered well and my makeup didn't end up patchy or cakey. Pic is of skin with skincare and beautybarrier primer. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This mineral SPF 50 priming lotion from Naked Sundays helps soothe and support the skin barrier while protecting your skin from the sun. It gives your skin a glowy, hydrated, and blurred finish. My foundation looks great on top of it and I don't experience any pilling.This is a great way to wear SPF with your makeup, but it can also be worn by itself.It's pretty thick, so a little goes a long way; it may take a while to blend in completely. It feels a little heavy on the skin at first, but once it dries down it's not as bad.After blending it in completely, there is no white cast. However, the glow is very bright and on medium or darker skin tones, it appears like a white cast in direct light. Because of this, I would personally only wear it under makeup instead of alone. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.
The collagen glow formulation was an absolute holy grail. I am devastated that it has been discontinued in favor of this new formula. The beauty barrier pills under makeup and irritated my skin.

I've been using this for a few days. This is a thicker, lotion-style SPF that feels more like a traditional sunscreen than a lightweight primer. For me, it took quite a bit of time to fully blend into the skin and did leave a slight white cast at first, especially if not worked in thoroughly. I found that applying it in smaller amounts and layering helped it absorb more evenly. There is a light scent upon application, but it fades fairly quickly and isn't noticeable after a few minutes.After using it for about a week, it felt comfortable on the skin once set and seemed to provide reliable sun protection throughout the day. It also worked reasonably well under makeup, though I personally prefer lighter textures for everyday. Overall, it's a solid product, but the heavier consistency may not be for everyone. I would rate it 4 out of 5 stars. I received this product as part of an educational promotion. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I've been using this priming lotion for a few weeks and I'm honestly really impressed. It gives my skin a smooth, hydrated base and helps my makeup go on so evenly. I love that I can also wear it alone on no-makeup days for a natural glow. It doesn't feel heavy or greasy, and the SPF 50 is a huge plus, especially for summer. My skin looks healthy, protected, and flawless every time I use it. It also layers really well with my other skincare and doesn't pill, which I really appreciate. I've noticed my makeup lasts longer throughout the day when I use this, and it keeps my skin looking fresh. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I've been using the BeautyBarrier Perfecting Priming Lotion SPF50 for about a week now and it's been really easy to add into my morning routine. My skin is combination and can get a bit sensitive, so I'm usually careful with SPF products. This one feels really comfortable right away. The texture is more like a light lotion than a typical sunscreen and it spreads easily without feeling thick or leaving a white cast.What I noticed first was how smooth my skin looked after applying it. It gives a soft blurred look that helps even things out before makeup. On days when I don't feel like wearing foundation I'll just use this on its own and my skin still looks more put together. When I do wear makeup it sits nicely on top and doesn't separate or look patchy.I also like that it doesn't feel heavy or clog my pores. I haven't had any breakouts while using it and my skin feels calm and hydrated during the day. It doesn't completely stop oil but it keeps things balanced enough where I'm not overly shiny. It's simple and does a few things at once without making my routine complicated, which is why I keep reaching for it. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I'm honestly so impressed with this primer! The texture is super lightweight and blends effortlessly into my skin without feeling greasy or heavy. It gives the prettiest glow while still smoothing everything out, so my makeup applies flawlessly on top. I love that it's SPF 50 because it makes protecting my skin so easy without adding extra steps to my routine. No white cast, no pilling, and it layers perfectly with my other products. I've been using it every morning, and my skin looks more radiant and hydrated all day. Definitely a new staple in my routine! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This is such a great spf. It doesn't feel greasy and absorbs pretty well leaving a soft and light layer on the skin. Not white cast and my morning routine is so much easier with this. No need to apply base, I feel it evens my complexion and makes my skin looks healthy. Pretty much a great product for me and will definitely repeat. Honestly zero complaints. It's one of those products that just works exactly how you want it to and you kind of wish you'd found it sooner. SPF50 with a formula this good is a win all around. I received this product as part of an educational promotion. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I've been using the Naked Sundays Perfect Priming Sunscreen under my makeup, and it has definitely become a staple in my daily routine. It provides hydration while leaving my skin feeling smooth and prepped for makeup application. I also appreciate that it hasn't caused any breakouts, which is always a concern when trying new products. Even with my oily skin, it performs really well throughout the day without feeling heavy or greasy. Overall, it's a great option for anyone looking for a sunscreen that doubles as a primer. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I love Naked Sundays products and was really excited to try this primer! SPF 50 in a primer is great and one of my favorite things about it. The primer leaves no white cast and performs well under make-up with no separation or pilling. It does blur the skin slightly and leaves a nice glow which makes it nice to wear even on no make-up days on its own. It is a little grippy, but not super sticky which is nice. The only thing I didn't love about this product is it is very thick and takes a good bit of time and effort to get it to fully absorb into the skin. The thickness makes it feel a bit heavy on the skin and that heavy feeling never fully goes away. When worn under makeup, I didn't notice it as much, but when trying to wear it on its own it just felt too thick. Reapplying made it feel even thicker and was really hard to get it to absorb a second time. If this product was just a little less thick I think it would be perfect, but for me, their gel primer is just way better. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I've been using the Naked Sundays Beauty Barrier Perfecting Priming Lotion SPF 50 for about a week and really like it. It feels lightweight and more like skincare than sunscreen. I spend a lot of time outside, so the SPF matters, but I love that it gives a natural glow. I'm very minimal with makeup, and this is enough on its own most days. I haven't had any irritation with my skin so far, and it layers well. It feels comfortable on my face all day and feels easy to wear, which makes me more consistent with applying SPF daily overall. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

The Beauty Barrier Mineral Perfecting Priming Lotion by Naked Sunday gives you glowing skin, sun protection, and blurs. This lightweight zinc-based lotion can be worn alone or under makeup. I prefer wearing it under makeup because it has a tint that is too dark for my fair skin tone. It has SPF 50 with a velvety satin-smooth finish. The formula is thick, so make sure to blend the lotion well. The ingredients used are Centella Asiatica, Zinc Oxide, Watermelon Extract, and Rice Amino Acids. If you have dry skin, this lotion does attach to dry patches. I have sensitivity around my eye area, and my eyes were watering. The squeeze tube packaging is colorful as well as easy to use. I received this product as part of an educational promotion. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This product was received as part of an educational promotion. This BeautyBarrier Perfecting Priming Lotion with SPF50 is definitely going to be my new summer go to. It's perfect for wearing underneath makeup. I love the fact that it has SPF in it because I don't have to worry about getting a sunburn. I love when makeup has it already added in! I feel as though it is comfortable wear as well, and doesn't feel sticky. This wears well underneath my makeup and I would recommend it to anyone who loves SPF included in their Primer! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This SPF perfecting priming sunscreen lotion is a great addition to my typical 'during the day' face routine. My first impression was noticing how thick the formula was. This would be the only thing I may point out that might deter someone from liking this. I like to mix it with my regular moisturizer just so I can spread it more efficiently otherwise I feel like I I have to use a lot to get it evenly spread out. Otherwise I really enjoyed the coverage and the smoothness it provides. I did not notice any white cast, which is really important to me for a mineral face sunscreen. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I've been a Naked Sundays fan for a while and used the older version of this product. This one is just as good and works really well under makeup. It almost has a silicone type texture without actually being silicone, but has that consistency that works well for blurring texture on the skin or possibly blurring pores. I also really appreciate that it has a higher spf. For reference, I have dry skin and live in a dry climate. I would recommend for someone looking for a new under makeup face sunscreen. I recieved this product as part of an educational program. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: The Ultimate MUA-Approved Skin Barrier SPF
avis.texte: As a professional makeup artist, I am extremely picky about the SPF I use on myself as well as clients, and the Naked Sundays Beauty Barrier- Priming Lotion SPF 50 has completely blown me away. This is a great hybrid product. It offers high levels of UVA/UVB protection, but the texture feels like a high end skincare treatment rather than your traditional SPF. I love how this leaves you with a soft-focus blurring finish. It smooths over pores and texture without settling into any fine line or clinging. Not overly sticky or heavy on the skin. And did I mention the GLOW! It's also acne and safe for sensitive skin which is huge for an SPF product. I like to wear this alone, but it can be used as a primer under makeup. I apply with fingers first then go over with a brush to really buff it in, leaving my skin with a gorgeous, soft suntan glow, without the orange-y ness. My skin looks healthy and radiant, never greasy. I received this product as part of an educational promotion, but all opinions expressed here are entirely my own and based on my professional experience. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: Primes, strengthens, and protects all in one
avis.texte: I definitely found my summer SPF primer. It comes out thick and with a foundation color to it but blends into the skin and absorbs nicely without feeling greasy at all. I love the list of ingredients some SPF can really break me out but this one just seems to better my skin . I love the illuminated look it gives the perfect amount of shimmer. I love wearing it alone for the hydration and SPF protection it offer while giving a blurring effect to your skin, but it's a great base for makeup as well. I love how nicely it layers and gives a smooth soft touch to your face. This is an awesome addition to your skincare and makeup. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I have been using this priming lotion for a few days now. This is a thick, mineral SPF that feels closer to a lotion than a traditional sunscreen or a primer. Initially I found this a little hard to fully blend into my skin with my traditional application, initially leaving my skin looking a little greasy. I modified my application and found applying small streaks all over my face to be most effective to fully absorb into my skin. Once worked in, I did not see any noticeable coloration of product. There was no overly noticeable scent. Once worked into the skin, this product is comfortable to wear, leaving my skin feeling glowy and moisturized. This product wears well under makeup, and gave my skin a glowy finish. I received this product as part of an educational promotion. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I'm not one who loves the smell of sunscreen, so I am always trying to find products that offer sun protection but don't reek of sunscreen smell. The Naked Sundays Beauty Barrier SPF 50 is a great option for sun protection with no abhorrent sunscreen smell (there is still a mild sunscreen scent, but it's tolerable). The product is slightly tinted but after thoroughly rubbing this into my skin (or using a dense buffing brush), I saw no visible tint on my skin. This also feels like it would be heavy, as it's a little bit thick but again, it rubs into my skin easily and dries down, and does not feel sticky, but I did feel as though there was a glow to my skin. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: A great substitute for physical sunscreen
avis.texte: The first impression i have here was "this is so thick" thicker than a real spf lotion. But as I gently spread it, it clearly absorbs into my skin so well, withouth leaving very sticky or greasy. it felt a bit heavy but it dries comfortably. It primed my face so well. I have partnered it with NS tint and they match perfectly. It leaves my skin very smooth and healthy looking. If you forgot your sunscreen this is a great solution, primer with SPF and you will not feel guilty about it. A great 3in1 product- moisturizer- primer- SPF! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: Great for priming with added protection!
avis.texte: I really enjoy using this primer every day since I got it. It is SUPER important to me that I wear sunscreen every day weather it is in a primer or a sunscreen. I love that this adds extra benefits though on top of sun protection. It totally smooths some of my fine lines. You can see from the first picture to the second, my skin looks MUCH more smooth. It does add a slight tint and slight coverage. If you have a rosacea like me I would not expect it to cover all the redness. Good news though, it did NOT trigger my rosacea or irritate it. It does have a slight sunscreen smell but other than that it is unscented. Overall, I have immensely enjoyed this apart of my daily routine alone or with additional makeup! Product was received as part of an educational promotion *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Designed as a smoothing, skin-perfecting primer, it not only creates the perfect base for makeup but also provides broad-spectrum mineral SPF50 protection, making it an ideal choice for daily wear. What sets this priming lotion apart is how it gently soothes and supports your skin barrier while delivering that high level of sun protection. The lightweight formula glides on smoothly, mattifying the skin without feeling heavy or greasy. It blurs imperfections, giving the skin a naturally polished finish that lasts all day. The mineral SPF gives reassurance without irritation, and layering makeup on top feels seamless. For busy mornings or anyone who prefers a streamlined beauty step, this primer offers both care and coverage in one. Overall, Naked Sundays BeautyBarrier Perfecting Priming Lotion SPF50 is a thoughtfully crafted product that delivers on its promises. It's an excellent choice if you want to protect, soothe, and perfect your skin effortlessly. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

The lotion has a shade of tint that perfectly matches my skin and makes it look a little warmer, alive, and radiant which as a naturally pale person, I really love! It also holds my makeup perfectly and better than my untinted drug store moisturizer. I think this is a great product for beach days or other days when I would be spending a lot of time in the harsh sun, because the SPF is so high whereas my usual moisturizers are closer to ~30 -- it's just that this product feels extremely thick to put on. I have a hard time spreading it out, and I don't want to use too much because the color rubs off very easily on clothes, so I don't want to moisturize my neck with it. But if you want a high SPF priming option for your face only that will look amazing under makeup, definitely try this! Received as part of an educational program. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I did not have a lot of expectations for this product, but I find myself loving it. The last few days I have been wearing it as a base with only concealer around my eyes and no need for a foundation… That is so unusual for me! It has a beautiful finish that makes my skin look hydrated and healthy. It blends in nicely and does not feel too heavy. It does not pill and It also plays well with the other makeup that I do put on top of it. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest opinion. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: No scent and comfortable on skin
avis.texte: I received this product as a part of an educational promotion.This SPF is very good. The cream is quite thick, but that actually makes it easier to work with, it glides on the skin really well and spreads evenly without effort. I don't need a lot of product to cover my face.There is no scent at all, which is a big plus for me. It also has a light tint, but once applied it almost disappears on the skin and doesn't look like foundation or anything heavy. After application my skin looks a bit shiny, so I lightly set it with a mattifying powder and it looks more natural. It doesn't clog my pores and feels comfortable during the day.I also like that it washes off easily with micellar water, no need to rub too much. Simple, easy, and does its job. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Love this product! My skin looks so healthy and flawless when I wear it, already received some compliments!It looks beautiful when worn alone or under foundation, I tried both ways and prefer wearing it alone. It gives my skin that glass skin effect, it's very moisturizing and soothing due to Centella Asiatica ingredient Love the added SPF 50 , it protects my skin , does not feel heavy on my face. Beautiful skincare+ makeup product in one,it's my new spring/summer favorite The colorful packaging is super fun too *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: A Great Addition to My SPF routine!
avis.texte: After using the Perfecting Priming Lotion SPF 50 for a little over a week, I've found myself in love with this product. My skin is acne prone, sensitive, and of the combination variety, so finding a primer that suits my needs can be difficult at times. However, I only have good things to say about my experiences! The Perfecting Priming Lotion hasn't caused breakouts on my skin and hydrates where I apply it without leaving the area feeling overly greasy. I have tried this SPF primer both with and without makeup, and I have to admit, I adore the glowy blurring effect it gives me with either method. I prefer to blend the product onto my face with my fingers and I've had no issues with texture or coverage as long as it's blended evenly. I also love that when wearing this SPF it doesn't leave a white cast, feel gritty, or dry out my skin. I highly recommend this Beauty Barrier product! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I love this sunscreen. I love that it's not white so I never feel like it's making me look ghostly. I really like the thick texture of the sunscreen. It applies nicely and I've started mixing it with my moisturizer as a 2 in 1. It makes me feel glowy and I like knowing I'm protected from the sun as we move into spring and summer. A definite add to the daily morning routine. I will say of you don't like a thick consistency then this will it be for you. It takes some work to get it to run in and spread but for me I like that. I have a super dry nose and it does kind of make my nose look dry because of the flaky skin I have so keep that in mind but it's not enough to make it where I won't use it. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This BeautyBarrier Mineral Perfecting Priming Lotion SPF50 has a nice, velvety texture. When I first applied the product, it felt a bit heavy, but once it was rubbed in and dried, it felt lighter. I also noticed a slight white cast when first applied, which disappeared once rubbed in. It can be worn alone or under makeup. I prefer to wear it as a priming base under makeup. It noticeably evens skin tone and wears well under makeup. It doesn't have a greasy feel and makeup doesn't settle into creases. As a beauty enthusiast who lives in a sunny environment and puts a lot of focus on sun protection, I really appreciate the high (50) and effective SPF. I do wish this product was all mineral, without the chemical filters though. I received this product as a part of an educational promotion. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I have been using the Naked Sundays Beauty Barrier Priming Lotion for a few weeks now and I really like it. At first I thought it was too thick, but it melts down into your skin and glides easily and evenly. I love the silky glowy finish that it has, providing the perfect base for my makeup. It helps to blur my pores and it doesn't settle into my fine lines. It doesn't peel off, so I love using it under my foundation or skin tint. Even though it is a thick formula, it doesn't irritate my skin or clog my pores. For me the best part is the SPF 50 protection without leaving a white cast. The packaging is really cute, but I wish the hole of the bottle was smaller because sometimes too much product comes out. Overall I really enjoy this product and I will recommend it. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This had been my go to sunscreen for my face. I have very sensitive skin and can't use any sort of chemical sunscreen or anything containing niacinamide (which unfortunately everybody seems to be adding to their products) . when I received my latest order of the sunscreen and applied it in the morning, I noticed by afternoon my face was red and burning. Couldn't figure out at first what caused it but then I checked the ingredients on the sunscreen I noticed it was no longer 100% mineral. Very deceptive on the companies part. They may think we won't notice the reformation, but my skin definitely did. and to top it off, they increased the price substantially. I will definitely be looking for a replacement.

avis.titre: Stinging eyes means it's a pass
avis.texte: I love Naked Sundays' Collagen Glow SPF for my sensitive skin, but Ulta doesn't sell it anymore so I tried this new formulation. Thev've added chemical sunscreen filters to this formula and they sting my eyes like crazy. Please bring back the 100% all-mineral formulation!

This brand is amazing. I have used many products from them already. I live in Florida SPF is a daily necessity for me. I think it's great that everything is SPF 50 and that they are now offering a primer that has barrier protection. This is a great product for layering or wearing alone. It has such amazing moisturizing and hydrating qualities. It makes this texture and complexion of your skin looking incredible. I would highly recommend this product and everything that naked Sundays have to offer. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: I like that it works well
avis.texte: I've been really enjoying this SPF! The texture is lightweight and smooth, it blends easily without leaving any white cast. It gives a soft blurring effect, so my skin looks more even and fresh right away.I like that it works well under makeup — no pilling or heaviness, which is a big plus. It also feels comfortable throughout the day and doesn't clog pores.Overall, it's a great everyday sunscreen if you want something that protects your skin while also giving a nice, natural finish.Received as a part of an educational promotion. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This sunscreen by Naked Sundays is a great product. I think the packaging is very cute and vibrant which is different from most products on the market. The formula itself was a good consistency and applied well to the face. It did not feel too dry or too oily. I also did not have any issues with a white case after applying the product which is a big win in my book. I also wore this sunscreen under make up and did not have any issues with applying makeup or with keeping the makeup on all day. All in all, I am impressed by this product. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

First, the packaging was really cute and fun. I liked the colors and holographic wording. It is small enough to throw in a travel bag as well. I really enjoyed how once this sunscreen was blended in, even though it was made with zinc, you couldn't see it. After going on a hike with it, I felt that the sun coverage was good, and it did not seep into my eyes, which is usually a concern with facial sunscreen. But, putting it on, it was very thick and sticky. This is worth it for the results though. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.
Used to be my favorite and now it's reformulated. Why do brands do this?? Sad I didn't buy extra of the old version.

This Naked Sundays Beauty Barrier Mineral Perfecting Priming Lotion is a new staple in my routine. I can wear it on its own. It also goes great underneath foundation. It gives the best glowy and dewy look to the skin. There is just enough pigment to give the skin a smooth look which is amazing. It definitely does its job protecting my skin from the sun also. I will also say, it lasts surprisingly long. Reapplication wasn't needed as much as with products I've used in the past. A little goes a long way as well. This lotion will be lasting me a long while. Ten out of ten recommend! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

this used to be HG for me but unfortunately, no longer. this product used to be all mineral however, now they have added chemical filters in the inactive ingredients. they ruined the product. there are plenty of chemical filter options, yet they felt the need to add them to a mineral product that was great only to destroy it. unreal.
love this spf primer, its great under makeup! Perfect for this summer.
